messages:
Sam L: Hey team — Acme (enterprise) requested our SOC 2 report and a signed bridge letter. They say they need it for procurement by EOD Fri. Legal requires NDA before sharing full reports. Can someone advise on quick path? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Priya N: Do we have a minimal redacted extract we can share without NDA? Or an interim ack?
Sam L: We have a redacted extract but client asked for the full report. They're asking for presigned S3 links to evidence too.
Jordan R: Presigned links are fine but expiry needs to be short. Could do 48h expiring presign with read-only perms.
Jordan R: If legal won't sign off immediately, fallback is to provide the SOC 2 cover letter + security posture summary doc.
Priya N: What exactly does legal need to sign off on for a 48h presign? Are they okay with 'interim bridge letter' instead?
Legal Bot: @Sam L @Priya N Standard process: NDA or a signed bridge letter on our template. We can issue the bridge letter but only after the customer signs our interim NDA or Acknowledgement.
Claire S: I can run the bridge letter template with redactions. If we provide presign links, they must be logged and we need a custody note in the ticket. Also require requestor email verification.
Sam L: Timeline from Acme: wants it by Friday. Can legal produce a one-paragraph bridge letter + presigned link option?
Legal Bot: I'll draft a one-paragraph interim ack: "Redwood Inference confirms availability of SOC 2 Type II report under terms. Production evidence will be shared under executed NDA or limited presigned access for 48 hours."
Sam L: Perfect — also customer asked about whether we can provide a short signed note confirming control coverage for encryption and key mgmt.
Priya N: We have a controls summary doc. I'll attach once legal okays redaction.
Jordan R: For presign: example command we use:
```aws s3 presign s3://redwood-soc2/acme-evidence.zip --expires-in 172800```
Priya N: Note: 172800 = 48h
Legal Bot: Draft will be sent to #legal-review-email@example.com. Claire, can you confirm redactions?
Claire S: Confirmed — I'll remove employee IDs, internal audit notes, and vendor-specific tickets. Send me the filename.
Sam L: Sending now. Thanks all. I'll update Acme after legal sends draft. :thumbsup:
